column9: Downstairs: the floor below, or the ground outside the building: 在樓下等你.

column3: Live, reside and "stay": 住在北京, 住三天. 亻 (person) is the meaning part and 主 gives the sound; both are zhù.
column9: Live, reside and "stay": 住在北京, 住三天. 亻 (person) is the meaning part and 主 gives the sound; both are zhù.

column3: On, above, up. After a noun: 桌子上 "on the table". As a verb: 上班, 上课, 上车 ("go to, get on"). It is a short stroke above a long one; 下 is the reverse.
column7: Class is starting, please sit down.
column9: On, above, up. After a noun: 桌子上 "on the table". As a verb: 上班, 上課, 上車 ("go to, get on"). It is a short stroke above a long one; 下 is the reverse.

column3: Below, down, and "get off, finish": 下车, 下班, 下课; also "fall" for rain: 下雨. It is a short stroke below a long one. After a verb 一下 softens it.
column9: Below, down, and "get off, finish": 下車, 下班, 下課; also "fall" for rain: 下雨. It is a short stroke below a long one. After a verb 一下 softens it.

column3: Inside: 家里, 书包里. 里 is read as a field 田 on earth 土. The opposite is 外: 里面 "inside", 外面 "outside".
column7: The book is in the schoolbag.
column9: Inside: 家裡, 書包裡. 里 is read as a field 田 on earth 土. The opposite is 外: 裡面 "inside", 外面 "outside".

column3: Outside, foreign: 门外, 外国, 外语. As a place word it follows the noun: 门外 "outside the door". The opposite is 里.
column7: There is someone outside the door.
column9: Outside, foreign: 門外, 外國, 外語. As a place word it follows the noun: 門外 "outside the door". The opposite is 裡.

column3: In front, before, ago. After a noun: 门前. After a time: 三年前 "three years ago". The 月 in it is a worn-down 舟 (boat), not the moon.
column6: Sān nián qián wǒ zhù zài Běijīng.
column7: Three years ago I lived in Beijing.
column9: In front, before, ago. After a noun: 門前. After a time: 三年前 "three years ago". The 月 in it is a worn-down 舟 (boat), not the moon.

column3: Behind, after: 门后, 三年后 "in three years".
column6: Sān nián hòu wǒ èrshí suì.
column7: In three years I will be twenty.
column9: Behind, after: 門後, 三年後 "in three years". 後 has a step 彳 and a foot 夂 held back by a thread 幺, "lagging behind".

column3: Left: 左边. It began as a picture of a left hand, and 工 (work) was added underneath later. 右 is the same with 口 instead: 左 ends in 工, 右 in 口.
column9: Left: 左邊. It began as a picture of a left hand, and 工 (work) was added underneath later. 右 is the same with 口 instead: 左 ends in 工, 右 in 口.

column3: Right: 右边. It began as 又, a right hand and the same sound yòu, and 口 was added as a mark with no meaning. 右 ends in 口, 左 in 工.
column9: Right: 右邊. It began as 又, a right hand and the same sound yòu, and 口 was added as a mark with no meaning. 右 ends in 口, 左 in 工.

column3: East: 东边. 东西 means "thing".
column6: Wǒ jiā zài xuéxiào de dōngbian.
column7: My home is east of the school.
column9: East: 東邊. 東 began as a bag tied at both ends; the sun 日 rising behind a tree 木 is a later reading. 東西 means "thing".

column3: West: 西边. Possibly a bird's nest, tied to the bird settling at sunset. 东西 is "thing" (and the East and West).
column7: The shop is west of the school.
column9: West: 西邊. Possibly a bird's nest, tied to the bird settling at sunset. 東西 is "thing" (and the East and West).

column3: South: 南边. It was borrowed for its sound; the old shape was a lidded vessel.
column7: His home is south of the school.
column9: South: 南邊. It was borrowed for its sound; the old shape was a lidded vessel.

column3: North: 北边, 北京 "northern capital". It is two people back to back; the word first meant "back", and "north" came from that.
column7: The school is north of the shop.
column9: North: 北邊, 北京 "northern capital". It is two people back to back; the word first meant "back", and "north" came from that.

column3: Middle, center, and in 中国 "China". It is a flagpole, drawn as a vertical line through a box.
column7: He studies at a middle school.
column9: Middle, center, and in 中國 "China". It is a flagpole, drawn as a vertical line through a box.

column3: Beside, next to: 在…旁边. 我旁边 "beside me". 边 means "side".
column9: Beside, next to: 在…旁邊. 我旁邊 "beside me". 邊 means "side".

column3: Middle, between: 两个人中间 "between two people". 中 plus 间 ("space").
column6: Shūdiàn zài liǎng ge shāngdiàn zhōngjiān.
column7: The bookshop is between two shops.
column9: Middle, between: 兩個人中間 "between two people". 中 plus 間 ("space").

column3: Above, on top, the upper side. Like the other place words in 边, the 边 is light: shàngbian.
column7: Your name is at the top.
column9: Above, on top, the upper side. Like the other place words in 邊, the 邊 is light: shàngbian.

column3: Below, underneath: 桌子下边 "under the table". Light 边: xiàbian.
column7: The book is under the table.
column9: Below, underneath: 桌子下邊 "under the table". Light 邊: xiàbian.

column3: Inside: 房间里边 "inside the room". Light 边: lǐbian.
column9: Inside: 房間裡邊 "inside the room". Light 邊: lǐbian.

column3: Outside: 外边很冷 "it is cold outside". Light 边: wàibian.
column9: Outside: 外邊很冷 "it is cold outside". Light 邊: wàibian.

column3: In front, ahead: 前边有一家商店 "there is a shop ahead". Light 边: qiánbian.
column7: There is a shop up ahead.
column9: In front, ahead: 前邊有一家商店 "there is a shop ahead". Light 邊: qiánbian.

column3: Behind, at the back. Light 边: hòubian.
column9: Behind, at the back. Light 邊: hòubian.

column3: On the left: 左边 is "the left side". Light 边: zuǒbian. The pair is 右边.
column7: My home is to the left of the school.
column9: On the left: 左邊 is "the left side". Light 邊: zuǒbian. The pair is 右邊.

column3: On the right. Light 边: yòubian. Used with 坐在 to say where someone sits.
column7: The teacher sits on my right.
column9: On the right. Light 邊: yòubian. Used with 坐在 to say where someone sits.

column3: East side. Light 边: dōngbian. Chinese lists compass points as 东南西北 ("east, south, west, north").
column7: There is a train station on the east side.
column9: East side. Light 邊: dōngbian. Chinese lists compass points as 東南西北 ("east, south, west, north").

column3: West side. This dictionary gives 西边 a full first tone on 边: xībiān. The compass order in Chinese is 东南西北, so west comes third.
column7: To the west there are mountains.
column9: West side. This dictionary gives 西邊 a full first tone on 邊: xībiān. The compass order in Chinese is 東南西北, so west comes third.

column3: South side: 南边. Light 边: nánbian. 南 is the second of 东南西北.
column7: My home is in the south.
column9: South side: 南邊. Light 邊: nánbian. 南 is the second of 東南西北.

column3: North side. This dictionary gives 北边 a full first tone on 边: běibiān. 北 is last in 东南西北.
column6: Xuéxiào běibiān yǒu yī jiā shūdiàn.
column7: North of the school there is a bookshop.
column9: North side. This dictionary gives 北邊 a full first tone on 邊: běibiān. 北 is last in 東南西北.

column3: Used twice, for two actions at once: 一边…一边… "while…ing, …ing". Put one before each verb.
column6: Tā yībiān zǒulù yībiān tīng gē.
column7: He listens to songs while he walks.
column9: Used twice, for two actions at once: 一邊…一邊… "while…ing, …ing". Put one before each verb.

column3: Look, watch, read: 看书, 看电视, 看电影; 看病 "see a doctor". It is a hand 手 over an eye 目, shading the eyes to see far.
column9: Look, watch, read: 看書, 看電視, 看電影; 看病 "see a doctor". It is a hand 手 over an eye 目, shading the eyes to see far.

column3: Listen, hear: 听歌, 听说 "I hear that". 听见 or 听到 is to actually hear something.
column9: Listen, hear: 聽歌, 聽說 "I hear that". 聽見 or 聽到 is to actually hear something. 聽 has 耳 "ear" on the left.

column3: Speak, say: 说汉语, 说话. 讠 (speech) is the meaning part and 兑 the sound, though duì no longer sounds like shuō.
column9: Speak, say: 說漢語, 說話. 言 (speech) is the meaning part and 兌 the sound, though duì no longer sounds like shuō.

column3: Read aloud, study: 读课文 "read the text aloud"; 读书 "study, go to school". 讠 (speech) is a left part.
column6: Qǐng dú yīxià zhè ge zì.
column9: Read aloud, study: 讀課文 "read the text aloud"; 讀書 "study, go to school". 言 (speech) is a left part.

column3: Write: 写字, 写汉字. It always takes an object or a result: 写错了.
column9: Write: 寫字, 寫漢字. It always takes an object or a result: 寫錯了.

column3: Ask: name the person first: 问老师 "ask the teacher". 口 (mouth) is the meaning part and 门 (mén) the sound, close to wèn.
column6: Tā wèn wǒ jiào shénme míngzi.
column7: He asked me what my name is.
column9: Ask: name the person first: 問老師 "ask the teacher". 口 (mouth) is the meaning part and 門 (mén) the sound, close to wèn.

column3: Answer, a verb and a noun: 回答问题 "answer a question"; 他的回答 "his answer". 回 ("return") plus 答 ("reply").
column9: Answer, a verb and a noun: 回答問題 "answer a question"; 他的回答 "his answer". 回 ("return") plus 答 ("reply").

column3: Be called: 我叫王明; or "call, tell to": 叫他来 "have him come". 口 (mouth) is the meaning part and 丩 the sound. 你叫什么名字？ is the standard question.
column6: Wǒ jiào Wáng Míng, nǐ jiào shénme?
column7: My name is Wang Ming, what's yours?
column9: Be called: 我叫王明; or "call, tell to": 叫他來 "have him come". 口 (mouth) is the meaning part and 丩 the sound. 你叫什麼名字？ is the standard question.

column3: Name: 你叫什么名字？ In 名, one explanation is 夕 (evening) over 口 (mouth): saying your name to be known in the dark. In 字, 子 gives the sound. The 字 is light: míngzi.
column9: Name: 你叫什麼名字？ In 名, one explanation is 夕 (evening) over 口 (mouth): saying your name to be known in the dark. In 字, 子 gives the sound. The 字 is light: míngzi.

column3: Tell: 告诉我 "tell me". The person comes straight after it, without 对: 告诉他, not 告诉对他. 诉 has 讠 (speech) as meaning part. The 诉 is light: gàosu.
column6: Qǐng gàosu wǒ nǐ de míngzi.
column9: Tell: 告訴我 "tell me". The person comes straight after it, without 對: 告訴他, not 告訴對他. 訴 has 言 (speech) as meaning part. The 訴 is light: gàosu.

column3: See, catch sight of: 看 plus 到, where 到 says the seeing worked. 我看到他了 "I saw him". Compare 看见.
column6: Wǒ kàndào nǐ de lǎoshī le.
column9: See, catch sight of: 看 plus 到, where 到 says the seeing worked. 我看到他了 "I saw him". Compare 看見.

column3: See, catch sight of, like 看到: 我看见他了. Negate it with 没: 没看见 "did not see", unlike 看, which is only "look".
column6: Nǐ kànjiàn wǒ de qiánbāo le ma?
column9: See, catch sight of, like 看到: 我看見他了. Negate it with 沒: 沒看見 "did not see", unlike 看, which is only "look".

column3: Hear: 听 plus 到 says the sound reached you. 我听到了 "I heard it". Compare 听见. 听 alone is "listen", which is trying.
column9: Hear: 聽 plus 到 says the sound reached you. 我聽到了 "I heard it". Compare 聽見. 聽 alone is "listen", which is trying.

column3: Hear, like 听到: 我听见有人叫我. The 见 ("see, perceive") after the verb says the sound reached you, as 看见 says the sight did. 听 alone is only "listen".
column9: Hear, like 聽到: 我聽見有人叫我. The 見 ("see, perceive") after the verb says the sound reached you, as 看見 says the sight did. 聽 alone is only "listen".

column3: Speak, talk: a verb and its object, so it can split: 说了很多话 "talked a lot". 话 means "words, speech". 说 and 话 both have the speech radical, 讠.
column9: Speak, talk: a verb and its object, so it can split: 說了很多話 "talked a lot". 話 means "words, speech". 說 and 話 both have the speech radical, 言.

column3: Study, go to school: 他在北京读书 "he studies in Beijing". It can also mean "read a book". 读 plus 书, "read" plus "book".
column9: Study, go to school: 他在北京讀書 "he studies in Beijing". It can also mean "read a book". 讀 plus 書, "read" plus "book".

column3: Dictation: 听 ("listen") plus 写 ("write"). The teacher reads out words and students write them down. Used as: 有听写, 做听写.
column9: Dictation: 聽 ("listen") plus 寫 ("write"). The teacher reads out words and students write them down. Used as: 有聽寫, 做聽寫.

column3: Smile, laugh: 笑了. With a person, "laugh at": 笑他. On top is ⺮ (bamboo) and below 夭 as the sound part; the oldest form had 草 and 犬 instead.
column9: Smile, laugh: 笑了. With a person, "laugh at": 笑他. On top is ⺮ (bamboo) and below 夭 as the sound part; the oldest form had 艸 and 犬 instead.

column3: Sing: 唱一首歌 "sing a song". 口 (mouth) is the meaning part and 昌 the sound.
column6: Nǐ huì chàng zhè shǒu gē ma?
column9: Sing: 唱一首歌 "sing a song". 口 (mouth) is the meaning part and 昌 the sound.

column3: Sing: a verb and its object, so it can split: 唱了一首歌. In 歌, 欠 is the meaning part and 哥 gives the sound, gē in both.
column9: Sing: a verb and its object, so it can split: 唱了一首歌. In 歌, 欠 is the meaning part and 哥 gives the sound, gē in both.

column3: See and "meet", seldom alone: 看见, 听见, 再见, 见面, 见到. When it means "meet", it takes a person: 我见过他 "I have met him".
column9: See and "meet", seldom alone: 看見, 聽見, 再見, 見面, 見到. When it means "meet", it takes a person: 我見過他 "I have met him". 見 shows a kneeling person with a big eye for a head.

column3: Meet, see each other: a verb and its object, so no object follows it. Say 跟朋友见面 "meet a friend", not 见面朋友.
column9: Meet, see each other: a verb and its object, so no object follows it. Say 跟朋友見面 "meet a friend", not 見面朋友.

column3: Introduce, explain: 介绍朋友 "introduce a friend"; 自我介绍 "introduce yourself". In 绍, 纟 (thread) is the meaning part and 召 the sound.
column4: 我来介绍一下，这是我的朋友。
column5: 我來介紹一下，這是我的朋友。
column6: Wǒ lái jièshào yīxià, zhè shì wǒ de péngyou.
column7: Let me introduce you, this is my friend.
column9: Introduce, explain: 介紹朋友 "introduce a friend"; 自我介紹 "introduce yourself". In 紹, 糹 (thread) is the meaning part and 召 the sound.

column3: Speech, words: 说话, 电话, 一句话 "a sentence". 讠 (speech) is the meaning part. A talk or chat is 谈话, and 会话 means "conversation".
column9: Speech, words: 說話, 電話, 一句話 "a sentence". 言 (speech) is the meaning part. A talk or chat is 談話, and 會話 means "conversation". The right part of 話 only looks like 舌 "tongue"; it is not related to it.

column3: Study, learn: 学汉语. 子 (child) is the bottom part of 学.
column9: Study, learn: 學漢語. 子 (child) is the bottom part of 學. In 學, two hands sit around 爻 and the 冖 was once 六; the child was added later.

column3: Student, a pupil of any level: 学 plus 生. For a fellow student you also hear 同学.
column6: Wǒmen bān yǒu èrshí ge xuésheng.
column9: Student, a pupil of any level: 學 plus 生. For a fellow student you also hear 同學.

column3: Study, learn: 学习汉语. Both verb and noun: 他的学习很好. Alone, 学 means "learn a skill" (学开车); 学习 is studying in general.
column7: He is studying in the library.
column9: Study, learn: 學習漢語. Both verb and noun: 他的學習很好. Alone, 學 means "learn a skill" (學開車); 學習 is studying in general.

column3: School (the place and institution): 我的学校. 校 has 木 (wood) as meaning part and 交 as sound part.
column9: School (the place and institution): 我的學校. 校 has 木 (wood) as meaning part and 交 as sound part.

column3: College, institute, school, faculty: 医学院 "medical school". 院 has 完 as sound part (wán against yuàn).
column7: He studies at the medical school.
column9: College, institute, school, faculty: 醫學院 "medical school". 院 has 完 as sound part (wán against yuàn).

column3: University, college: 上大学 "go to university". 大 ("big") plus 学.
column7: He goes to university in Beijing.
column9: University, college: 上大學 "go to university". 大 ("big") plus 學.

column3: University student: 大学 plus 生 ("student").
column7: My older sister is a university student.
column9: University student: 大學 plus 生 ("student").

column3: Primary school: 上小学. 小 ("small") plus 学. Next comes 中学 and then 大学.
column7: My younger brother is in primary school.
column9: Primary school: 上小學. 小 ("small") plus 學. Next comes 中學 and then 大學.

column3: Primary-school pupil: 小学 plus 生 ("student"). The ending 生 also works in 中学生 and 大学生, so the whole ladder is built the same way.
column9: Primary-school pupil: 小學 plus 生 ("student"). The ending 生 also works in 中學生 and 大學生, so the whole ladder is built the same way.

column3: Secondary school, lower and upper together: 中 ("middle") plus 学.
column7: I teach Chinese at a secondary school.
column9: Secondary school, lower and upper together: 中 ("middle") plus 學.

column3: Secondary-school student: 中学 plus 生. It covers pupils from the first year of lower secondary school to the last of upper secondary school.
column9: Secondary-school student: 中學 plus 生. It covers pupils from the first year of lower secondary school to the last of upper secondary school.

column3: Go to school, attend school: 上 ("go to") plus 学. About school in general, not one class; for a class, 上课.
column7: My younger brother goes to school at eight.
column9: Go to school, attend school: 上 ("go to") plus 學. About school in general, not one class; for a class, 上課.

column3: School is out: 放 ("let go") plus 学. 放学后 means "after school".
column6: Fàngxué hòu wǒmen qù wánr ba.
column9: School is out: 放 ("let go") plus 學. 放學後 means "after school".

column3: Teaching building of a school or university: 教学 ("teaching") plus 楼 ("building"). 教 is read jiào here, not jiāo.
column7: We have class in the teaching building.
column9: Teaching building of a school or university: 教學 ("teaching") plus 樓 ("building"). 教 is read jiào here, not jiāo.

column3: Teach: teacher, then person, then subject: 她教我汉语. 攵 (a stick, the teaching cane) and 子 (child): teaching a child. Read jiāo when it stands alone as "teach"; inside words such as 教学楼 and 教育 it is jiào.
column9: Teach: teacher, then person, then subject: 她教我漢語. 攵 (a stick, the teaching cane) and 子 (child): teaching a child. Read jiāo when it stands alone as "teach"; inside words such as 教學樓 and 教育 it is jiào.

column3: Have class, go to class, teach a class: 上课了 "class has begun". 课 has 讠 (speech) as meaning part and 果 (guǒ) as sound part, though kè no longer sounds like guǒ. 上学 is school in general.
column9: Have class, go to class, teach a class: 上課了 "class has begun". 課 has 言 (speech) as meaning part and 果 (guǒ) as sound part, though kè no longer sounds like guǒ. 上學 is school in general.

column3: Class is over: 下课了. The opposite of 上课. 下 here means "finish".
column7: Class is over, let's go eat.
column9: Class is over: 下課了. The opposite of 上課. 下 here means "finish".

column3: Class, lesson: 第三课 "lesson 3", 一节课 "one class period". 讠 (speech) is the meaning part.
column6: Wǒ jīntiān yǒu sān jié kè.
column9: Class, lesson: 第三課 "lesson 3", 一節課 "one class period". 言 (speech) is the meaning part.

column3: Textbook: 课 ("lesson") plus 本 ("book"). 请打开课本 is a teacher's usual instruction.
column9: Textbook: 課 ("lesson") plus 本 ("book"). 請打開課本 is a teacher's usual instruction.

column3: Text of a lesson, the passage in a textbook: 读课文. In 文 the shape is read as a man with a tattooed chest; today it means "writing, text".
column9: Text of a lesson, the passage in a textbook: 讀課文. In 文 the shape is read as a man with a tattooed chest; today it means "writing, text".

column3: Book: 一本书, 看书, 买书. A textbook is 课本 and a notebook 本子.
column9: Book: 一本書, 看書, 買書. A textbook is 課本 and a notebook 本子. 書 has 聿 "writing brush" for the meaning and 者 for the sound.

column3: Schoolbag, book bag: 书 ("book") plus 包 ("bag"). 包 is also in 钱包 "wallet", and in 包子 where it means "wrap". Carry one: 背书包.
column9: Schoolbag, book bag: 書 ("book") plus 包 ("bag"). 包 is also in 錢包 "wallet", and in 包子 where it means "wrap". Carry one: 背書包.

column3: Notebook: 本 ("book, volume") plus the light ending 子, běnzi. Count with 个 or 本: 两个本子.
column6: Wǒ mǎi le liǎng ge běnzi.
column9: Notebook: 本 ("book, volume") plus the light ending 子, běnzi. Count with 個 or 本: 兩個本子.

column3: Character, written word: 汉字, 写字, 一个字. 宀 (roof) is the meaning part and 子 the sound (zǐ against zì).
column7: How do you read this character?
column9: Character, written word: 漢字, 寫字, 一個字. 宀 (roof) is the meaning part and 子 the sound (zǐ against zì).

column3: Chinese characters: 汉 plus 字. 汉 is "Han"; it was first the name of the Han river, with 氵 (water) as its meaning part. 写汉字 is what this app practices.
column7: I am learning to write Chinese characters.
column9: Chinese characters: 漢 plus 字. 漢 is "Han"; it was first the name of the Han river, with 氵 (water) as its meaning part. 寫漢字 is what this app practices.

column3: Chinese, the language: 学汉语, 说汉语. The HSK is the 汉语水平考试, "Chinese language level test". 语 has 讠 (speech) as meaning part and 吾 as sound part.
column9: Chinese, the language: 學漢語, 說漢語. The HSK is the 漢語水平考試, "Chinese language level test". 語 has 言 (speech) as meaning part and 吾 as sound part.

column3: Chinese as a language, especially in writing: 学中文, 中文书 "Chinese books". 中 ("China") plus 文 ("writing").
column9: Chinese as a language, especially in writing: 學中文, 中文書 "Chinese books". 中 ("China") plus 文 ("writing").

column3: Foreign language: 外 ("foreign") plus 语 ("language"). 学外语 "study a foreign language".
column7: What foreign language do you want to learn?
column9: Foreign language: 外 ("foreign") plus 語 ("language"). 學外語 "study a foreign language".

column3: Take a test: 考汉语 "take a Chinese test". 考 is a variant of 老: both show an old person leaning on a cane, which is why they share 耂.
column7: We have a Chinese test tomorrow.
column9: Take a test: 考漢語 "take a Chinese test". 考 is a variant of 老: both show an old person leaning on a cane, which is why they share 耂.

column3: Exam, test, and "to take an exam": 明天有考试; 考试了吗？ 试 has 讠 (speech) as meaning part and 式 as sound part, both shì.
column9: Exam, test, and "to take an exam": 明天有考試; 考試了嗎？ 試 has 言 (speech) as meaning part and 式 as sound part, both shì.

column3: Try: 试一下 "give it a try"; 试穿 "try on". 讠 (speech) is the meaning part and 式 the sound, both shì.
column9: Try: 試一下 "give it a try"; 試穿 "try on". 言 (speech) is the meaning part and 式 the sound, both shì.

column3: Page: 第三页 "page 3". 页 first meant a person's head, and was later used for "page", through 叶 ("leaf, page").
column9: Page: 第三頁 "page 3". 頁 first meant a person's head, and was later used for "page", through 葉 ("leaf, page").

column3: Class, a group of students who learn together: 我们班. Not a lesson, which is 课. It is a knife 刂 cutting between two pieces of jade 王.
column9: Class, a group of students who learn together: 我們班. Not a lesson, which is 課. It is a knife 刂 cutting between two pieces of jade 王.

column3: Want to: 我想去. Also "miss": 我想你; and "think": 想一想. Gentler than 要. 心 (heart) is the meaning part and 相 the sound, which differs from xiǎng only in tone.
column9: Want to: 我想去. Also "miss": 我想你; and "think": 想一想. Gentler than 要. 心 (heart) is the meaning part and 相 the sound, which differs from xiǎng only in tone.

column3: Want, need, will: 我要一杯茶; 我要走了 "I'm about to go". Stronger than 想. 不要 means "don't", not just "don't want". It is a woman 女 under a drawing of hands at the waist, which became 覀.
column7: I'll have a cup of tea.
column9: Want, need, will: 我要一杯茶; 我要走了 "I'm about to go". Stronger than 想. 不要 means "don't", not just "don't want". It is a woman 女 under a drawing of hands at the waist, which became 覀.

column3: Can, for something learned: 我会说汉语. Also "will": 明天会下雨; and "meeting": 开会.
column9: Can, for something learned: 我會說漢語. Also "will": 明天會下雨; and "meeting": 開會.

column3: Can, when circumstances or permission allow: 我今天不能去. Where 会 is a learned skill, 能 is ability or possibility. It is a bear, with two 匕 for paws; later borrowed for "can".
column9: Can, when circumstances or permission allow: 我今天不能去. Where 會 is a learned skill, 能 is ability or possibility. It is a bear, with two 匕 for paws; later borrowed for "can".

column3: Like: 喜欢茶, 喜欢吃. 很喜欢 is "like a lot". The second syllable is light: xǐhuan. 喜 is read as a drum 壴 over a mouth 口; 欢 has 欠 (breath) as meaning part.
column9: Like: 喜歡茶, 喜歡吃. 很喜歡 is "like a lot". The second syllable is light: xǐhuan. 喜 is read as a drum 壴 over a mouth 口; 歡 has 欠 (breath) as meaning part.

column3: Love: 我爱你. Stronger than 喜欢. Also "love to do": 他爱吃肉. 爱 has 友 (friend) at the bottom. It also begins 爱好 "hobby" and 爱情 "romantic love".
column9: Love: 我愛你. Stronger than 喜歡. Also "love to do": 他愛吃肉. 愛 has 心 (heart) in the middle. It also begins 愛好 "hobby" and 愛情 "romantic love".

column3: Hobby: 你的爱好是什么？ Here 好 is read hào, "to like", not hǎo. 爱 ("love") plus 好 ("be fond of").
column9: Hobby: 你的愛好是什麼？ Here 好 is read hào, "to like", not hǎo. 愛 ("love") plus 好 ("be fond of").

column3: Good-looking, and "worth watching or reading": 好看的电影. The same pattern as 好吃 and 好听. The opposite is 难看.
column7: This piece of clothing looks nice.
column9: Good-looking, and "worth watching or reading": 好看的電影. The same pattern as 好吃 and 好聽. The opposite is 難看.

column3: Pleasant to hear: 好听的歌. 好 plus 听, "good to listen to". The opposite is 难听.
column9: Pleasant to hear: 好聽的歌. 好 plus 聽, "good to listen to". The opposite is 難聽.

column3: Happy, glad: 很高兴认识你 "nice to meet you". 兴 is read xìng here, not xīng. The opposite is 不高兴 "unhappy" or 难过 "sad".
column7: I'm very glad to meet you.
column9: Happy, glad: 很高興認識你 "nice to meet you". 興 is read xìng here, not xīng. The opposite is 不高興 "unhappy" or 難過 "sad". 興 shows four hands 舁 lifting an object.

column3: Get angry: 别生气 "don't be angry"; 生他的气 "be angry with him". 生 is "produce", and 气 here stands for 怒气 "anger": "produce anger". A verb and its object, so 生了气 splits it.
column9: Get angry: 別生氣 "don't be angry"; 生他的氣 "be angry with him". 生 is "produce", and 氣 here stands for 怒氣 "anger": "produce anger". A verb and its object, so 生了氣 splits it.

column3: Feel, think: 我觉得很好 "I think it's good". A soft way to give an opinion. 觉 is read jué here; in 睡觉 it is jiào. 觉 has 见 (see) as meaning part.
column6: Wǒ juéde zhè ge hěn hǎo.
column7: I think this one is good.
column9: Feel, think: 我覺得很好 "I think it's good". A soft way to give an opinion. 覺 is read jué here; in 睡覺 it is jiào. 覺 has 見 (see) as meaning part.

column3: Do, make: 做饭 "cook", 做什么 "do what". It began as a later variant of 作, and the two sound the same, zuò; today 做 is for doing and making things, and 作 is mostly found inside set words such as 工作 and 作业. 亻 (person) is the left part.
column9: Do, make: 做飯 "cook", 做什麼 "do what". It began as a later variant of 作, and the two sound the same, zuò; today 做 is for doing and making things, and 作 is mostly found inside set words such as 工作 and 作業. 亻 (person) is the left part.

column3: Do, work at (gàn), in speech: 干什么, 这件事我来干. 干 is a shield. Careful or written Chinese prefers 做; 干吗 "why, what for" is spoken.
column6: Zhè jiàn shì wǒ lái gàn.
column9: Do, work at (gàn), in speech: 幹什麼, 這件事我來幹. 干 is a shield. Careful or written Chinese prefers 做; 幹嘛 "why, what for" is spoken.

column3: Buy: 买东西 "go shopping". The opposite, 卖 (mài, "sell"), looks almost the same and sounds the same but for the tone, so check which one you mean.
column6: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi yī běn shū.
column7: I want to buy a book.
column9: Buy: 買東西 "go shopping". The opposite, 賣 (mài, "sell"), looks almost the same and sounds the same but for the tone, so check which one you mean.

column3: Thing, stuff: 买东西 "go shopping", 好东西 "good stuff". With a light xi, dōngxi. Read dōngxī with full tone, it means "east and west".
column9: Thing, stuff: 買東西 "go shopping", 好東西 "good stuff". With a light xi, dōngxi. Read dōngxī with full tone, it means "east and west".

column3: Take, hold: 拿书 "hold a book"; 拿来 "bring". 手 (hand) is the lower part.
column6: Qǐng bāng wǒ ná yīxià shū.
column7: Please hold the book for me.
column9: Take, hold: 拿書 "hold a book"; 拿來 "bring". 手 (hand) is the lower part.

column3: Put, place: 放在桌子上 "put it on the table". Also "let go": 放学, 放假. 攵 (action, a hand with a stick) is the meaning part and 方 the sound; fàng and fāng differ by tone.
column9: Put, place: 放在桌子上 "put it on the table". Also "let go": 放學, 放假. 攵 (action, a hand with a stick) is the meaning part and 方 the sound; fàng and fāng differ by tone.

column3: Give (as a gift), "see off", "deliver": 送你一本书; 送朋友 "see a friend off". 辶 (walk) is the meaning part.
column6: Wǒ sòng nǐ yī běn shū.
column9: Give (as a gift), "see off", "deliver": 送你一本書; 送朋友 "see a friend off". 辶 (walk) is the meaning part.

column3: Use: 用手机 "use a phone"; 用中文说 "say it in Chinese". 不用 means "no need".
column9: Use: 用手機 "use a phone"; 用中文說 "say it in Chinese". 不用 means "no need".

column3: Useful: 有 plus 用, "have use". The pattern 有 plus a noun makes an adjective: 有用, 有名. The opposite is 没用.
column9: Useful: 有 plus 用, "have use". The pattern 有 plus a noun makes an adjective: 有用, 有名. The opposite is 沒用.

column3: Get, obtain: 得到帮助 "get help". 得 is read dé in this word; the light particle 得 is de. The old form is a hand grabbing a cowry shell, with 彳 (step) added.
column6: Tā dédào le yī běn shū.
column9: Get, obtain: 得到幫助 "get help". 得 is read dé in this word; the light particle 得 is de. The old form is a hand grabbing a cowry shell, with 彳 (step) added.

column3: Give back, return: 还书 "return books", 还钱 "pay back". The same character is also hái "still". 辶 (walk) is the meaning part.
column9: Give back, return: 還書 "return books", 還錢 "pay back". The same character is also hái "still". 辶 (walk) is the meaning part.

column3: Hit, and the verb for many actions: 打球, 打电话, 打车. Which verb goes with which noun is learned phrase by phrase. 扌 (hand) is the meaning part and 丁 the sound.
column9: Hit, and the verb for many actions: 打球, 打電話, 打車. Which verb goes with which noun is learned phrase by phrase. 扌 (hand) is the meaning part and 丁 the sound.

column3: Open, "turn on", "start, run": 开门 "open the door", 开车 "drive", 开会 "hold a meeting". The opposite is 关: 关门 "close the door", 关灯 "turn off the light".
column9: Open, "turn on", "start, run": 開門 "open the door", 開車 "drive", 開會 "hold a meeting". The opposite is 關: 關門 "close the door", 關燈 "turn off the light".

column3: Close, "turn off": 关门, 关电视. The opposite is 开: 开门, 开电视.
column9: Close, "turn off": 關門, 關電視. The opposite is 開: 開門, 開電視. 關 began as a door 門 with two sticks barring it.

column3: Close, with the result that it is shut: 关上门 "shut the door". The 上 after the verb says the closing is done. The opposite is 打开.
column9: Close, with the result that it is shut: 關上門 "shut the door". The 上 after the verb says the closing is done. The opposite is 打開.

column3: Open, with the result that it is open: 打开门 "open the door", 打开书 "open the book". 打 plus 开, "strike open". Also for turning something on: 打开电视. The opposite is 关上.
column9: Open, with the result that it is open: 打開門 "open the door", 打開書 "open the book". 打 plus 開, "strike open". Also for turning something on: 打開電視. The opposite is 關上.

column3: Move: 别动 "don't move". Mostly found inside longer words. 力 (strength) is the meaning part.
column9: Move: 別動 "don't move". Mostly found inside longer words. 力 (strength) is the meaning part and 重 (zhòng) is the sound part, close to dòng.

column3: Movement, action: a physical motion, in exercise, dance or gesture. 动作很快 "quick movements". 动 ("move") plus 作 ("make").
column9: Movement, action: a physical motion, in exercise, dance or gesture. 動作很快 "quick movements". 動 ("move") plus 作 ("make").

column3: Big. Also "old" for people's age: 你多大了？ It is a person facing forward, arms out. 太 is 大 with a dot added, so don't add one by accident.
column9: Big. Also "old" for people's age: 你多大了？ It is a person facing forward, arms out. 太 is 大 with a dot added, so don't add one by accident.

column3: Small, little: 小房间. Also a friendly prefix before a surname: 小王 for a younger person. It is three dots, perhaps grains of sand.
column6: Zhè ge bēizi tài xiǎo le.
column9: Small, little: 小房間. Also a friendly prefix before a surname: 小王 for a younger person. It is three dots, perhaps grains of sand.

column3: Tall, high: 他很高. It is a picture of a tall building. For comparison, 他比我高 "he is taller than me".
column9: Tall, high: 他很高. It is a picture of a tall building. For comparison, 他比我高 "he is taller than me".

column3: New, before a noun: 新书, 新房子. Opposite of 旧. On the right is 斤 (axe): the character first meant "chop wood" and was borrowed for "new".
column6: Wǒ mǎi le yī ge xīn bēizi.
column9: New, before a noun: 新書, 新房子. Opposite of 舊. On the right is 斤 (axe): the character first meant "chop wood" and was borrowed for "new".

column3: Old, for people or long-standing things: 老朋友 "old friend". For objects that are not new, 旧 is used instead. It is an old man with long hair leaning on a cane.
column6: Tā shì wǒ de lǎo péngyou.
column9: Old, for people or long-standing things: 老朋友 "old friend". For objects that are not new, 舊 is used instead. It is an old man with long hair leaning on a cane.

column3: Bad, broken: 电脑坏了 "the computer is broken"; 坏人 "a bad person". 土 (earth) is the meaning part. The earth part is there because what rots goes back to earth.
column9: Bad, broken: 電腦壞了 "the computer is broken"; 壞人 "a bad person". 土 (earth) is the meaning part. The earth part is there because what rots goes back to earth.

column3: Fast: 快走 "hurry". Also "soon": 快八点了 "it's almost eight". 忄 (heart) is the meaning part and 夬 the sound, the same 夬 as in 块.
column9: Fast: 快走 "hurry". Also "soon": 快八點了 "it's almost eight". 忄 (heart) is the meaning part and 夬 the sound, the same 夬 as in 塊.

column3: Slow: 慢走 is a goodbye to someone leaving, "take care". 忄 (heart) is the meaning part and 曼 the sound; both are màn.
column6: Nǐ zǒu de tài màn le.
column9: Slow: 慢走 is a goodbye to someone leaving, "take care". 忄 (heart) is the meaning part and 曼 the sound; both are màn.

column3: Difficult: 难写 "hard to write". 难 plus a verb works like 好 plus a verb: 难吃 "bad to eat". Read nàn it means "disaster".
column7: Chinese characters are hard to write.
column9: Difficult: 難寫 "hard to write". 難 plus a verb works like 好 plus a verb: 難吃 "bad to eat". Read nàn it means "disaster".

column3: Expensive: 太贵了. Also polite "your" in 您贵姓？ "what is your surname?". 贝 (shell, once used as money) is the lower part.
column9: Expensive: 太貴了. Also polite "your" in 您貴姓？ "what is your surname?". 貝 (shell, once used as money) is the lower part.

column3: White and "bright": 白天 "daytime". There are two theories, an acorn or a human head. 百 is 白 with 一 on top, bǎi against bái.
column6: Zhè jiàn yīfu shì bái de.
column7: This piece of clothing is white.
column9: White and "bright": 白天 "daytime". There are two theories, an acorn or a human head. 百 is 白 with 一 on top, bǎi against bái.

column3: Heavy: 书包很重. Read zhòng as in 重要. It is a person carrying a bag, with 土 added to stand for the ground.
column9: Heavy: 書包很重. Read zhòng as in 重要. It is a person carrying a bag, with 土 added to stand for the ground.

column3: Dry (gān): 衣服干了 "the clothes are dry". 干杯 "cheers" means "dry the cup". The opposite is 湿 "wet".
column9: Dry (gān): 衣服乾了 "the clothes are dry". 乾杯 "cheers" means "dry the cup". The opposite is 溼 "wet".

column3: Clean: 房间很干净. 洗干净 "wash clean". Here 干 is gān and 净 jìng. The opposite is 脏 "dirty"; before a noun add 的: 干净的衣服.
column9: Clean: 房間很乾淨. 洗乾淨 "wash clean". Here 乾 is gān and 淨 jìng. The opposite is 髒 "dirty"; before a noun add 的: 乾淨的衣服.

column3: Poor, lacking: 他的汉语很差. For time, "short of": 差五分三点 "five to three". Read chā it means "difference".
column6: Xiànzài chà wǔ fēn sān diǎn.
column9: Poor, lacking: 他的漢語很差. For time, "short of": 差五分三點 "five to three". Read chā it means "difference".

column3: Far: 学校很远; 离…远 "far from…". 辶 (walk) is the meaning part and 元 the sound, close to yuǎn.
column6: Wǒ jiā lí xuéxiào hěn yuǎn.
column7: My home is far from school.
column9: Far: 學校很遠; 離…遠 "far from…". 辶 (walk) is the meaning part and 袁 the sound, close to yuǎn.

column3: Famous: 有 ("have") plus 名 ("name"). 有名的人 "a famous person". Same pattern as 有用.
column9: Famous: 有 ("have") plus 名 ("name"). 有名的人 "a famous person". Same pattern as 有用.

column3: Important: 很重要. 重 ("heavy") plus 要 ("essential"). 重 is read zhòng here, not chóng.
column9: Important: 很重要. 重 ("heavy") plus 要 ("essential"). 重 is read zhòng here, not chóng.

column3: Serious, conscientious: 认真学习 "study conscientiously". 认 ("recognize") plus 真 ("real"). In 认, 讠 (speech) is the meaning part and 人 the sound, differing only in tone: rèn and rén.
column9: Serious, conscientious: 認真學習 "study conscientiously". 認 ("recognize") plus 真 ("real"). In 認, 言 (speech) is the meaning part and 忍 the sound, differing only in tone: rèn and rěn.

column3: Body and "health": 身体好 "healthy", 身体不好 "not well". 身 began as a picture of a pregnant woman. A parting wish is 注意身体 "take care of yourself".
column9: Body and "health": 身體好 "healthy", 身體不好 "not well". 身 began as a picture of a pregnant woman. A parting wish is 注意身體 "take care of yourself".

column3: On one's body, on one's person: 身上没有钱 "I have no money on me". Light 上: shēnshang.
column7: I have no money on me.
column9: On one's body, on one's person: 身上沒有錢 "I have no money on me". Light 上: shēnshang.

column3: Hand: 洗手; 手机. It is a hand with the fingers splayed. At the left of characters it becomes 扌, as in 打, 拿 and 找.
column9: Hand: 洗手; 手機. It is a hand with the fingers splayed. At the left of characters it becomes 扌, as in 打, 拿 and 找.

column3: Mouth, and the measure word for family members: 四口人. Also "opening": 门口, 路口. It is an open mouth. Keep it apart from 日 (sun), which has a stroke inside.
column6: Tā jiā yǒu sān kǒu rén.
column7: There are three people in his family.
column9: Mouth, and the measure word for family members: 四口人. Also "opening": 門口, 路口. It is an open mouth. Keep it apart from 日 (sun), which has a stroke inside.

column3: Illness: 他的病好了 "his illness has gone". Also "to be ill": 他病了. 疒 (sickness) is the meaning part and 丙 the sound (bǐng, close to bìng).
column7: He has recovered from his illness.
column9: Illness: 他的病好了 "his illness has gone". Also "to be ill": 他病了. 疒 (sickness) is the meaning part and 丙 the sound (bǐng, close to bìng).

column3: See a doctor (as a patient), and "treat a patient" (as a doctor): 去医院看病. 看 here means "to examine".
column7: I'm going to the hospital to see a doctor tomorrow.
column9: See a doctor (as a patient), and "treat a patient" (as a doctor): 去醫院看病. 看 here means "to examine".

column3: Fall ill: 他生病了. 生 here means "come about", as in 生气: 生 plus 病. A verb and its object.
column9: Fall ill: 他生病了. 生 here means "come about", as in 生氣: 生 plus 病. A verb and its object.

column3: Tired: 我很累, and for tiring work: 工作很累. The reading with a field and silk is a folk etymology.
column9: Tired: 我很累, and for tiring work: 工作很累. The reading with a field and silk is a folk etymology.

column3: Sleep: 睡一会儿 "have a nap". 目 (eye) is the meaning part and 垂 the sound, chuí against shuì.
column9: Sleep: 睡一會兒 "have a nap". 目 (eye) is the meaning part and 垂 the sound, chuí against shuì.

column3: Sleep, go to bed: a verb and its object, so 睡了一觉 "had a sleep". 觉 is read jiào here, not jué.
column7: I go to bed at ten.
column9: Sleep, go to bed: a verb and its object, so 睡了一覺 "had a sleep". 覺 is read jiào here, not jué.

column3: Hungry: 我饿了 "I'm hungry". 饣 (food) is the meaning part and 我 the sound, though wǒ is far from è now.
column6: Wǒ è le, wǒmen chīfàn ba.
column9: Hungry: 我餓了 "I'm hungry". 飠 (food) is the meaning part and 我 the sound, though wǒ is far from è now.

column3: Thirsty: 我渴了. 氵 (water) is the meaning part and 曷 the sound. 又饿又渴 is "both hungry and thirsty".
column6: Wǒ hěn kě, xiǎng hē shuǐ.
column7: I'm very thirsty, I want some water.
column9: Thirsty: 我渴了. 氵 (water) is the meaning part and 曷 the sound. 又餓又渴 is "both hungry and thirsty".

column3: Electricity and "lightning", mostly the start of other words: 电话, 电脑, 电视, 电影. Also 电梯 "elevator" and 电池 "battery".
column7: The power is out at home.
column9: Electricity and "lightning", mostly the start of other words: 電話, 電腦, 電視, 電影. Also 電梯 "elevator" and 電池 "battery".

column3: Phone, phone call: 打电话 "make a call"; 电话号码 "phone number". 电 ("electric") plus 话 ("speech").
column6: Nǐ de diànhuà hàomǎ shì duōshao?
column9: Phone, phone call: 打電話 "make a call"; 電話號碼 "phone number". 電 ("electric") plus 話 ("speech").

column3: Computer: 电 ("electric") plus 脑 ("brain"). 脑 has ⺼ (flesh) as its meaning part. 开电脑 "turn on the computer".
column9: Computer: 電 ("electric") plus 腦 ("brain"). 腦 has ⺼ (flesh) as its meaning part. 開電腦 "turn on the computer".

column3: Television: 看电视. 视 has 见 (see) as meaning part and 示 as sound part, which is also shì.
column9: Television: 看電視. 視 has 見 (see) as meaning part and 示 as sound part, which is also shì.

column3: Television set, the machine: 买电视机. 机 has 木 (wood) as meaning part and 几 as sound part, jī against jǐ. 看电视 is "watch TV".
column9: Television set, the machine: 買電視機. 機 has 木 (wood) as meaning part and 幾 as sound part, jī against jǐ. 看電視 is "watch TV".

column3: Movie, film: 看电影; 电影院 "cinema". 影 first meant "shadow"; 彡 is the meaning part and 景 the sound.
column7: Do you want to watch a movie?
column9: Movie, film: 看電影; 電影院 "cinema". 影 first meant "shadow"; 彡 is the meaning part and 景 the sound.

column3: Mobile phone: 手 ("hand") plus 机 ("machine"). 用手机 "use a phone". 手机号 is a mobile number.
column6: Wǒ de shǒujī zài zhuōzi shang.
column7: My phone is on the table.
column9: Mobile phone: 手 ("hand") plus 機 ("machine"). 用手機 "use a phone". 手機號 is a mobile number.

column3: Make a phone call: 打 plus 电话. The person called goes before the verb: 给他打电话 "call him".
column9: Make a phone call: 打 plus 電話. The person called goes before the verb: 給他打電話 "call him".

column3: Go online: 上 ("get on") plus 网 ("net"). A verb and its object: 上了网. 上网看新闻 "read the news online".
column7: I go online in the evening.
column9: Go online: 上 ("get on") plus 網 ("net"). A verb and its object: 上了網. 上網看新聞 "read the news online".

column3: Online, on the internet: 网上买东西 "shop online". As a place word, it follows 在 and comes before the verb.
column9: Online, on the internet: 網上買東西 "shop online". As a place word, it follows 在 and comes before the verb.

column3: Song: 一首歌; 唱歌. 欠 is the meaning part and 哥 gives the sound, gē in both.
column9: Song: 一首歌; 唱歌. 欠 is the meaning part and 哥 gives the sound, gē in both.

column3: Play, have fun, hang out: 去哪儿玩儿. 玩 has 王 (jade) as meaning part and 元 as sound part (yuán against wán). The spoken ending makes it wánr.
column9: Play, have fun, hang out: 去哪兒玩兒. 玩 has 王 (jade) as meaning part and 元 as sound part (yuán against wán). The spoken ending makes it wánr.

column3: Fun, interesting to play with: 好 plus 玩儿, like 好吃 and 好看. 这里很好玩儿 "this is a fun place".
column9: Fun, interesting to play with: 好 plus 玩兒, like 好吃 and 好看. 這裡很好玩兒 "this is a fun place".

column3: Joke, kid around: 开 ("make") plus 玩笑 ("joke"). 别开玩笑 means "you're kidding".
column9: Joke, kid around: 開 ("make") plus 玩笑 ("joke"). 別開玩笑 means "you're kidding".

column3: Ball and "ball game": 一个球; 打球. 王 (jade) is the meaning part and 求 the sound, qiú in both; it first named a kind of jade.
column9: Ball and "ball game": 一個球; 打球. 王 (jade) is the meaning part and 求 the sound, qiú in both; it first named a kind of jade.

column3: Play ball games: 打 plus 球. 打球 is for games like basketball or tennis; football is 踢球, "kick the ball".
column7: We play ball in the afternoon.
column9: Play ball games: 打 plus 球. 打球 is for games like basketball or tennis; football is 踢球, "kick the ball".

column3: Country: 中国, 国家. In 国, 玉 (jade, treasure) sits inside the border 囗. Country names end in it: 美国, 英国, 法国; a foreigner is 外国人.
column9: Country: 中國, 國家. In 國, 或 sits inside the border 囗. Country names end in it: 美國, 英國, 法國; a foreigner is 外國人.

column3: Country, nation: 国 plus 家. 每个国家 "every country". Used for the state; for a country's people, 人: 中国人.
column6: Nǐ qù guo jǐ ge guójiā?
column7: How many countries have you been to?
column9: Country, nation: 國 plus 家. 每個國家 "every country". Used for the state; for a country's people, 人: 中國人.

column3: Abroad: 去国外 "go abroad". A place, not a describing word: 国外 is abroad, 外国 is foreign (外国人).
column9: Abroad: 去國外 "go abroad". A place, not a describing word: 國外 is abroad, 外國 is foreign (外國人).

column3: Foreign country, before a noun "foreign": 外国朋友, 外国人. Compare 国外 "abroad", which is a place.
column6: Wǒ yǒu hěn duō wàiguó péngyou.
column9: Foreign country, before a noun "foreign": 外國朋友, 外國人. Compare 國外 "abroad", which is a place.

column3: China: 中 ("middle") plus 国 ("country"). 中国人 is a Chinese person. 中 is also read zhòng in other words.
column9: China: 中 ("middle") plus 國 ("country"). 中國人 is a Chinese person. 中 is also read zhòng in other words.

column3: Beijing: 北 ("north") plus 京 ("capital", as in 京城). 京 is a picture of a tall building. From 1928 to 1949, when it was not the capital, it was called 北平. A proper name, so the pinyin is capitalized.
column9: Beijing: 北 ("north") plus 京 ("capital", as in 京城). 京 is a picture of a tall building. From 1928 to 1949, when it was not the capital, it was called 北平. A proper name, so the pinyin is capitalized.

column3: Shop, store: 去商店; 一家商店. 店 has 广 (a building) as meaning part and 占 (zhàn) as sound part, the same 占 as in 点 and 站.
column7: What time does the shop close?
column9: Shop, store: 去商店; 一家商店. 店 has 广 (a building) as meaning part and 占 (zhàn) as sound part, the same 占 as in 點 and 站.

column3: Shopping mall, big store. 场 means "open space": 土 (earth) is the meaning part. A 商店 is a shop; a 商场 is a large one with many.
column7: We're going to the mall to buy clothes.
column9: Shopping mall, big store. 場 means "open space": 土 (earth) is the meaning part. A 商店 is a shop; a 商場 is a large one with many.

column3: Hospital: 医 plus 院. 去医院 "go to the hospital"; 看病 is what you do there. 院 has 完 as sound part (wán, close to yuàn).
column9: Hospital: 醫 plus 院. 去醫院 "go to the hospital"; 看病 is what you do there. 院 has 完 as sound part (wán, close to yuàn).

column3: Cinema: 电影 plus 院 ("hall, institution"). 在电影院看电影 "watch a movie at the cinema".
column9: Cinema: 電影 plus 院 ("hall, institution"). 在電影院看電影 "watch a movie at the cinema".

column3: Ground, land: 地上 "on the ground"; 地方 "place". 土 (earth) is the meaning part and 也 the sound. The light particle de (慢慢地走) is a different job for the same character.
column7: There is water on the ground.
column9: Ground, land: 地上 "on the ground"; 地方 "place". 土 (earth) is the meaning part and 也 the sound. The light particle de (慢慢地走) is a different job for the same character.

column3: Place: 好地方 "nice place", 什么地方 "what place". 方 is light: dìfang.
column9: Place: 好地方 "nice place", 什麼地方 "what place". 方 is light: dìfang.

column3: Location, venue: 时间和地点 "time and place". 点 here means "point".
column6: Qǐng gàosu wǒ shíjiān hé dìdiǎn.
column7: Please tell me the time and place.
column9: Location, venue: 時間和地點 "time and place". 點 here means "point".

column3: On the ground, on the floor: 书在地上. Light 上: dìshang.
column7: The book is on the floor.
column9: On the ground, on the floor: 書在地上. Light 上: dìshang.

column3: Map: 一张地图; 看地图. 图 is "picture". A world map is 世界地图, and a place is shown 在地图上 "on the map".
column9: Map: 一張地圖; 看地圖. 圖 is "picture". A world map is 世界地圖, and a place is shown 在地圖上 "on the map".

column3: Restaurant on the mainland. In Taiwan it usually means "hotel", and some famous mainland hotels have it in their names, such as 北京饭店. 饭 ("meal") plus 店 ("shop").
column6: Zhè ge fàndiàn de cài hěn hǎochī.
column7: The food at this restaurant is delicious.
column9: Restaurant on the mainland. In Taiwan it usually means "hotel", and some famous mainland hotels have it in their names, such as 北京飯店. 飯 ("meal") plus 店 ("shop").

column3: Bookshop: 书 plus 店. 在书店买书 "buy books at the bookshop".
column7: The bookshop is next to the school.
column9: Bookshop: 書 plus 店. 在書店買書 "buy books at the bookshop".

column3: Library: 图 ("picture") plus 书 plus 馆 ("hall"). 馆 has 饣 (food) as meaning part and 官 (guān) as sound part, and names buildings for public use.
column9: Library: 圖 ("picture") plus 書 plus 館 ("hall"). 館 has 飠 (food) as meaning part and 官 (guān) as sound part, and names buildings for public use.

column3: Vehicle: car, bus, bicycle: 坐车, 开车, 车站. It is a picture of a two-wheeled cart seen from above. Count cars with 辆: 一辆车; a train is 火车.
column9: Vehicle: car, bus, bicycle: 坐車, 開車, 車站. It is a picture of a two-wheeled cart seen from above. Count cars with 輛: 一輛車; a train is 火車.

column3: Car: 开汽车, 坐汽车. 汽 has 氵 (water) as meaning part and 气 as sound part (qì in both); it is read as water in the form of air, steam. 汽车 is literally "steam vehicle".
column9: Car: 開汽車, 坐汽車. 汽 has 氵 (water) as meaning part and 气 as sound part (qì in both); it is read as water in the form of air, steam. 汽車 is literally "steam vehicle".

column3: Train: 火 ("fire") plus 车 ("vehicle"). 坐火车; 火车站. 火 is a picture of flames, written 灬 at the bottom of characters.
column7: What time does the train arrive?
column9: Train: 火 ("fire") plus 車 ("vehicle"). 坐火車; 火車站. 火 is a picture of flames, written 灬 at the bottom of characters.

column3: Airplane: 飞 ("fly") plus 机 ("machine"). 坐飞机 "go by plane". Count with 架: 一架飞机. The airport is 机场, a ticket 机票.
column9: Airplane: 飛 ("fly") plus 機 ("machine"). 坐飛機 "go by plane". Count with 架: 一架飛機. The airport is 機場, a ticket 機票.

column3: Fly: 飞机, 飞到北京. It is a picture of a bird in flight. Taking off is 起飞 and landing is 降落.
column9: Fly: 飛機, 飛到北京. It is a picture of a bird in flight. Taking off is 起飛 and landing is 降落.

column3: Station, stop: 火车站, 汽车站. 车 plus 站, "vehicle standing place". 站 has 立 (stand) as meaning part and 占 as sound part.
column7: There are a lot of people at the station.
column9: Station, stop: 火車站, 汽車站. 車 plus 站, "vehicle standing place". 站 has 立 (stand) as meaning part and 占 as sound part.

column3: On the vehicle, in the car: 车上有很多人 "the bus is crowded". Light 上: chēshang.
column7: My book is in the car.
column9: On the vehicle, in the car: 車上有很多人 "the bus is crowded". Light 上: chēshang.

column3: Ticket for a bus or train: 买车票. 车 plus 票. The measure word is 张: 一张车票.
column6: Wǒ mǎi le liǎng zhāng chēpiào.
column9: Ticket for a bus or train: 買車票. 車 plus 票. The measure word is 張: 一張車票.

column3: Airport: 机 ("plane") plus 场 ("open ground"). 去机场; 机场很大.
column7: I'm waiting for you at the airport.
column9: Airport: 機 ("plane") plus 場 ("open ground"). 去機場; 機場很大.

column3: Plane ticket: 机 ("plane") plus 票 ("ticket"). 买机票 "buy a plane ticket"; the measure word is 张: 一张机票. Compare 车票 for a bus or train.
column7: The plane ticket is too expensive.
column9: Plane ticket: 機 ("plane") plus 票 ("ticket"). 買機票 "buy a plane ticket"; the measure word is 張: 一張機票. Compare 車票 for a bus or train.

column3: Ticket: 车票, 机票, 门票. Count with 张: 一张票. The lower 示 replaced an earlier 火 (fire); the word first meant sparks rising and then "token" or "ticket".
column9: Ticket: 車票, 機票, 門票. Count with 張: 一張票. The lower 示 replaced an earlier 火 (fire); the word first meant sparks rising and then "token" or "ticket".

column3: Admission ticket, for a park, museum or show: 门 ("door") plus 票. 买门票.
column7: An admission ticket is twenty yuan.
column9: Admission ticket, for a park, museum or show: 門 ("door") plus 票. 買門票.

column3: Get on a bus, train or car: 上 plus 车. 请上车. The opposite is 下车.
column9: Get on a bus, train or car: 上 plus 車. 請上車. The opposite is 下車.

column3: Get off a bus, train or car: 下 plus 车. 在哪儿下车？ asks where. The opposite is 上车.
column9: Get off a bus, train or car: 下 plus 車. 在哪兒下車？ asks where. The opposite is 上車.

column3: Road: 马路, 走路; also a route, as of a bus: 三路车. 足 (foot) is the meaning part and 各 the sound (gè against lù).
column9: Road: 馬路, 走路; also a route, as of a bus: 三路車. 足 (foot) is the meaning part and 各 the sound (gè against lù).

column3: Intersection, crossing: 路 plus 口 ("opening"). 在路口等 "wait at the intersection".
column9: Intersection, crossing: 路 plus 口 ("opening"). 在路口等 "wait at the intersection".

column3: On the way, on the road: 路上小心 "be careful on the way", said to someone setting off. Light 上: lùshang.
column9: On the way, on the road: 路上小心 "be careful on the way", said to someone setting off. Light 上: lùshang.

column3: Road, street with traffic: 马 ("horse") plus 路. 过马路 "cross the street".
column9: Road, street with traffic: 馬 ("horse") plus 路. 過馬路 "cross the street".

column3: Drive: 开 plus 车. A verb and its object: 开了一个小时的车. 你会开车吗？ Compare 打车, which is to hail a taxi.
column9: Drive: 開 plus 車. A verb and its object: 開了一個小時的車. 你會開車嗎？ Compare 打車, which is to hail a taxi.

column3: Take a taxi, hailing or calling one: 打 plus 车. Not 开车, which is driving yourself.
column9: Take a taxi, hailing or calling one: 打 plus 車. Not 開車, which is driving yourself.

column3: Clothes: 一件衣服; 穿衣服. 衣 is a picture of a garment's upper part. In 服 the 月 is not a moon: it is a worn-down tray or boat shape. The 服 is light: yīfu.
column7: This piece of clothing is expensive.
column9: Clothes: 一件衣服; 穿衣服. 衣 is a picture of a garment's upper part. In 服 the 月 is not a moon: it is a worn-down tray or boat shape. The 服 is light: yīfu.

column3: Wear clothes and shoes: 穿衣服, 穿白衣服. It is 穴 (cave) over 牙 (tooth), meaning "go through". For a hat or glasses a different verb is used.
column9: Wear clothes and shoes: 穿衣服, 穿白衣服. It is 穴 (cave) over 牙 (tooth), meaning "go through". For a hat or glasses a different verb is used.

column3: Wash: 洗手, 洗衣服. 氵 (water) is the meaning part and 先 the sound (xiān against xǐ).
column7: I'm going to wash my hands.
column9: Wash: 洗手, 洗衣服. 氵 (water) is the meaning part and 先 the sound (xiān against xǐ).

column3: Weather: 天 ("sky") plus 气 ("air"). 天气好 "good weather"; ask 天气怎么样？
column9: Weather: 天 ("sky") plus 氣 ("air"). 天氣好 "good weather"; ask 天氣怎麼樣？

column3: Rain: 大雨 "heavy rain". It is a cloud with drops falling. 雨 is at the top of 零 and 电.
column9: Rain: 大雨 "heavy rain". It is a cloud with drops falling. 雨 is at the top of 零 and 電.

column3: Rain: 下 ("fall") plus 雨. No subject is needed: 下雨了 "it has started to rain".
column9: Rain: 下 ("fall") plus 雨. No subject is needed: 下雨了 "it has started to rain".

column3: Wind: 大风 "strong wind"; 有风. "The wind blows" is 刮风: 今天刮风.
column9: Wind: 大風 "strong wind"; 有風. "The wind blows" is 颳風: 今天颳風. 風 was borrowed from the bird 鳳 for its sound.

column3: Mountain: 山上 "on the mountain". It is three peaks. Don't mix it with 出, whose top is not a mountain.
column9: Mountain: 山上 "on the mountain". It is three peaks. Don't mix it with 出, whose top is not a mountain.

column3: Tree: 一棵树. 木 (tree) is the meaning part; 树 has 对 as its second part. Its parts: 树叶 "leaf", 树枝 "branch"; a forest is 树林.
column6: Shān shang yǒu hěn duō shù.
column7: There are many trees on the mountain.
column9: Tree: 一棵樹. 木 (tree) is the meaning part; 樹 has 尌 as its second part. Its parts: 樹葉 "leaf", 樹枝 "branch"; a forest is 樹林. 樹 was first written 尌, "to plant a tree"; 木 was added later to tell the two apart.

column3: Flower, and "to spend": 花钱 "spend money". 艹 (plant) is the meaning part and 化 the sound, huà against huā.
column9: Flower, and "to spend": 花錢 "spend money". 艹 (plant) is the meaning part and 化 the sound, huà against huā.

column3: Hot: 天气很热; 热水. Also "popular", as in 热闹. 灬 (fire) is the meaning part. The opposite is 冷.
column9: Hot: 天氣很熱; 熱水. Also "popular", as in 熱鬧. 灬 (fire) is the meaning part. The opposite is 冷.

column3: Cold: 天气很冷. 冫 (ice) is the meaning part and 令 the sound, close to lěng; the same 令 is in 零.
column9: Cold: 天氣很冷. 冫 (ice) is the meaning part and 令 the sound, close to lěng; the same 令 is in 零.

column3: Go to work, be at work: 上 plus 班 ("shift"). A verb and its object. For a class, say 上课.
column9: Go to work, be at work: 上 plus 班 ("shift"). A verb and its object. For a class, say 上課.

column3: Finish work, leave work: 下 plus 班. 下班后 "after work". The opposite is 上班.
column7: What time do you finish work?
column9: Finish work, leave work: 下 plus 班. 下班後 "after work". The opposite is 上班.

column3: Work: a job (找工作) or a verb (在北京工作). 工 is a picture of a tool and 作 means "do".
column9: Work: a job (找工作) or a verb (在北京工作). 工 is a picture of a tool and 作 means "do".

column3: Have a meeting: 开 ("hold") plus 会 ("meeting"). A verb and its object: 开了一个会.
column7: We have a meeting in the afternoon.
column9: Have a meeting: 開 ("hold") plus 會 ("meeting"). A verb and its object: 開了一個會.

column3: Matter, affair: 什么事 "what's the matter"; 有事 "have something on". It is a hand holding a flag, as in "doing one's job".
column7: What can I do for you?
column9: Matter, affair: 什麼事 "what's the matter"; 有事 "have something on". It is a hand holding a flag, as in "doing one's job".

column3: No problem, it's nothing, also "I'm free". A reply to an apology: 没事儿，不用谢. The ending 儿 is spoken: méishìr.
column7: No problem, no need to thank me.
column9: No problem, it's nothing, also "I'm free". A reply to an apology: 沒事兒，不用謝. The ending 兒 is spoken: méishìr.

column3: Busy: 我很忙. 忄 (heart) is the meaning part and 亡 the sound. 忘 has the same 亡 and looks alike, but with 心 underneath: 忙 máng, 忘 wàng.
column9: Busy: 我很忙. 忄 (heart) is the meaning part and 亡 the sound. 忘 has the same 亡 and looks alike, but with 心 underneath: 忙 máng, 忘 wàng.

column3: Prepare, get ready: 准备早饭; 准备 plus a verb is "plan to".
column9: Prepare, get ready: 準備早飯; 準備 plus a verb is "plan to". 備 is read as a person 亻 carrying a quiver, "ready".

column3: Rest, take a break: 休息一下. 休 is a person 亻 leaning against a tree 木; 息 is a nose 自 over a heart 心, "to breathe". The 息 is light: xiūxi.
column9: Rest, take a break: 休息一下. 休 is a person 亻 leaning against a tree 木; 息 is a nose 自 over a heart 心, "to breathe". The 息 is light: xiūxi.

column3: Have time off, a holiday for school or work: 放 ("release") plus 假. 假 is read jià here. For one person's leave, 请假.
column7: We have a day off tomorrow.
column9: Have time off, a holiday for school or work: 放 ("release") plus 假. 假 is read jià here. For one person's leave, 請假.

column3: Ask for leave: 请 ("ask for") plus 假 (jià, "vacation"). A verb and its object: 请了一天假 "took a day off". Compare 放假 "to have a holiday", when everyone is off.
column7: I need to ask for leave tomorrow.
column9: Ask for leave: 請 ("ask for") plus 假 (jià, "vacation"). A verb and its object: 請了一天假 "took a day off". Compare 放假 "to have a holiday", when everyone is off.

column3: Help: 帮我买 "buy it for me". The helped person comes first, then the action: 帮 plus person plus verb. 帮 has 邦.
column9: Help: 幫我買 "buy it for me". The helped person comes first, then the action: 幫 plus person plus verb. 幫 has 封.

column3: Help, do a favor: a verb and its object, so no object follows it. Say 帮我的忙 or 帮他一个忙, not 帮忙我. 谢谢你帮忙 is "thank you for helping".
column9: Help, do a favor: a verb and its object, so no object follows it. Say 幫我的忙 or 幫他一個忙, not 幫忙我. 謝謝你幫忙 is "thank you for helping".

column3: Know a fact: 我知道; 我不知道. For people and places use 认识 instead. 知 has 口 (mouth) as meaning part and 矢 as sound part.
column6: Wǒ bù zhīdào tā de míngzi.
column9: Know a fact: 我知道; 我不知道. For people and places use 認識 instead. 知 has 口 (mouth) as meaning part and 矢 as sound part.

column3: Know a person, "recognize" a character: 我认识他; 认识这个字. For a fact, use 知道. Light 识: rènshi. In 认, 人 gives the sound, differing in tone (rèn, rén).
column6: Nǐ rènshi zhè ge zì ma?
column9: Know a person, "recognize" a character: 我認識他; 認識這個字. For a fact, use 知道. Light 識: rènshi. In 認, 忍 gives the sound, differing in tone (rèn, rěn).

column3: Remember, "note down": 记得, 记住, 记笔记. 讠 (speech) is the meaning part and 己 the sound, jǐ against jì. 己 is easy to mix with 巳 and 已, so copy the shape carefully.
column6: Wǒ jì bu zhù zhè ge zì.
column9: Remember, "note down": 記得, 記住, 記筆記. 言 (speech) is the meaning part and 己 the sound, jǐ against jì. 己 is easy to mix with 巳 and 已, so copy the shape carefully.

column3: Remember (still have in mind): 我记得他的名字. The opposite is 忘记 or 忘了. Light 得: jìde.
column9: Remember (still have in mind): 我記得他的名字. The opposite is 忘記 or 忘了. Light 得: jìde.

column3: Memorize, remember firmly: 记住这个字. 住 after a verb says the thing stays put. Negative: 记不住 "can't hold it in mind".
column9: Memorize, remember firmly: 記住這個字. 住 after a verb says the thing stays put. Negative: 記不住 "can't hold it in mind".

column3: Forget: usually with 了: 我忘了 "I forgot". 心 (heart) is the meaning part and 亡 the sound, wáng against wàng. 忙 has the same 亡, but 忄 at the left.
column6: Wǒ wàng le nǐ de diànhuà hàomǎ.
column9: Forget: usually with 了: 我忘了 "I forgot". 心 (heart) is the meaning part and 亡 the sound, wáng against wàng. 忙 has the same 亡, but 忄 at the left.

column3: Forget: 忘记 plus an object: 忘记了他的名字; 别忘记 "don't forget". Same meaning as 忘, with 记 added.
column7: Don't forget to close the door.
column9: Forget: 忘記 plus an object: 忘記了他的名字; 別忘記 "don't forget". Same meaning as 忘, with 記 added.

column3: Understand: 我明白了 "I get it". 明 ("bright") plus 白 ("clear"). The 白 is light: míngbai.
column9: Understand: 我明白了 "I get it". 明 ("bright") plus 白 ("clear"). The 白 is light: míngbai.

column3: Knowledge: 有知识 "knowledgeable". 知 ("know") plus 识 ("recognize"). 识 has 讠 (speech) as meaning part and 只 as sound part. The 识 is light: zhīshi.
column6: Shū lǐ yǒu hěn duō zhīshi.
column7: There is a lot of knowledge in books.
column9: Knowledge: 有知識 "knowledgeable". 知 ("know") plus 識 ("recognize"). 識 has 言 (speech) as meaning part and 戠 as sound part. The 識 is light: zhīshi.

column3: Wait: 等我 "wait for me" takes the person directly, no 对. ⺮ (bamboo) is the meaning part; it stood for bamboo strips used to sort writing. 寺 gives the sound.
column9: Wait: 等我 "wait for me" takes the person directly, no 對. ⺮ (bamboo) is the meaning part; it stood for bamboo strips used to sort writing. 寺 gives the sound.

column3: Look for: 找朋友, 找工作. The popular story of a hand 扌 looking for a halberd 戈 is a mnemonic, not the character's origin. 找到 is "find".
column6: Wǒ zài zhǎo wǒ de shǒujī.
column9: Look for: 找朋友, 找工作. The popular story of a hand 扌 looking for a halberd 戈 is a mnemonic, not the character's origin. 找到 is "find".

column3: Find, having looked: 找到 plus the thing. The negative splits it: 找不到 "can't find".
column6: Wǒ zhǎodào wǒ de qiánbāo le.
column9: Find, having looked: 找到 plus the thing. The negative splits it: 找不到 "can't find".

column3: And, "with": 我和你 "you and I". It joins nouns, not sentences or verbs. 禾 (hé) gives the sound and 口 is the meaning part, "harmony".
column6: Wǒ hé wǒ mèimei shì tóngxué.
column7: My younger sister and I are classmates.
column9: And, "with": 我和你 "you and I". It joins nouns, not sentences or verbs. 禾 (hé) gives the sound and 口 is the meaning part, "harmony".

column3: With, "and", "follow": 跟我来 "follow me"; 跟朋友一起去; 跟…一样 "the same as". 足 (foot) is the meaning part and 艮 the sound, gēn in both.
column9: With, "and", "follow": 跟我來 "follow me"; 跟朋友一起去; 跟…一樣 "the same as". 足 (foot) is the meaning part and 艮 the sound, gēn in both.

column3: From: 从北京来 "come from Beijing"; 从…到… "from … to …". The character is two 人 (people), one following the other.
column6: Wǒ cóng bā diǎn xué dào shí diǎn.
column7: I study from eight to ten.
column9: From: 從北京來 "come from Beijing"; 從…到… "from … to …". The character is two 人 (people), one following the other.

column3: Than, for comparing: A 比 B plus an adjective, 他比我高. After 比 do not add 很: not 他比我很高. It is two spoons 匕 side by side.
column9: Than, for comparing: A 比 B plus an adjective, 他比我高. After 比 do not add 很: not 他比我很高. It is two spoons 匕 side by side.

column3: Give, "for": 给我 "give me"; 给他打电话 "call him". 纟 (thread) is the meaning part and 合 the sound, though hé is far from gěi.
column6: Wǒ gěi māma mǎi le huā.
column9: Give, "for": 給我 "give me"; 給他打電話 "call him". 糹 (thread) is the meaning part and 合 the sound, though hé is far from gěi.

column3: Together: 我们一起去. It goes before the verb. The same as 一块儿.
column9: Together: 我們一起去. It goes before the verb. The same as 一塊兒.

column3: The same: A 跟 B 一样, 我的书跟你的一样. Add an adjective for "as … as": 跟他一样高. 样 has 木 (tree) as meaning part and 羊 as sound part.
column6: Wǒ de shū gēn nǐ de yīyàng.
column7: My book is the same as yours.
column9: The same: A 跟 B 一樣, 我的書跟你的一樣. Add an adjective for "as … as": 跟他一樣高. 樣 has 木 (tree) as meaning part and 羕 as sound part.

column3: Finally, last: 最后一个 "the last one". 最 ("most") plus 后 ("after").
column7: In the end we all went home.
column9: Finally, last: 最後一個 "the last one". 最 ("most") plus 後 ("after").

column3: Or, in questions: 你喝茶还是喝水？ A statement uses 或者 instead. Also "had better, still prefer": 还是你去吧.
column6: Nǐ hē chá háishi hē shuǐ?
column7: Do you want tea or water?
column9: Or, in questions: 你喝茶還是喝水？ A statement uses 或者 instead. Also "had better, still prefer": 還是你去吧.

column3: Also, there is also: 还有一本书. As a question, 还有吗？ means "anything else?".
column9: Also, there is also: 還有一本書. As a question, 還有嗎？ means "anything else?".

column3: Most: 最大, 最好, 最喜欢. It goes before an adjective or verb. It is also the first part of 最后 and 最好.
column9: Most: 最大, 最好, 最喜歡. It goes before an adjective or verb. It is also the first part of 最後 and 最好.

column3: Best, and "had better": 你最好休息 "you'd better rest". 最 plus 好.
column7: You had better go to bed early.
column9: Best, and "had better": 你最好休息 "you'd better rest". 最 plus 好.

column3: Other, else: 别的人 "other people", 别的东西 "something else". Light 的: biéde. 别 here is "other", not "don't".
column6: Nǐ hái yǒu biéde shì ma?
column7: Do you have anything else on?
column9: Other, else: 別的人 "other people", 別的東西 "something else". Light 的: biéde. 別 here is "other", not "don't".
